subject: physical-education

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of planning across a longer horizon with phases in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe balancing development, maintenance, and recovery blocks using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply managing competing demands: school, work, and activity in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving deload and taper concepts in plain terms; correct it and explain why.
Connect building in review points and objective decision rules with adapting a plan when circumstances change and explain how one affects the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Design a full periodized cycle for a self-chosen capability or activity goal, including phase structure, review points, and pre-committed rules for when to progress, hold, or deload.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated safe participation and self-management criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill cues or movement quality criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated tactical or training reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated self-assessment and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Self-Directed Program Design and Periodization?
